reviews.author: IHAN Cafe
reviews.text:
I purchased four items at the Mapo Gongde store tonight, including a small product called W3500 Makeup Remover Tissue. At checkout, the cashier asked if I wanted to buy a shopping bag like I normally would. After swiping my card and receiving my tax refund, I took the three items from the counter to a nearby counter and placed them in my bag. It wasn't until I got back to the hotel and checked the bill that I realized I hadn't brought any makeup remover wipes. It was strange. The cashier was right next to me, and after processing my payment, I immediately took my shopping cart and called the next customer. This is truly unacceptable! The cashier knew this item existed. It would have been ok if I hadn't paid, but since the cashier had already paid, I think the cashier may have known that I didn't take the items I already paid for, but didn't tell me.

This is my first time experiencing something like this in Seoul during my trip to Korea. There was one time in Jeju Island where a teddy bear brand customer was ripped off, but other than that. I don’t want to see Olive Young’s image tarnished!

#South Korea
Olive Young
